statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking changes to yutto's public API.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. The PR renames many importable, non-underscore modules (yutto.bilibili_typing -> yutto.media, yutto.parser -> yutto.input_parser, yutto.mcp -> yutto.mcp_server, yutto.path_resolver -> yutto.path_templates, utils.funcutils -> utils.functional) and start_downloader -> process_download, so Python import paths change. But yutto is a CLI with only the 'yutto = yutto.__main__:main' entry point (unchanged) and no documented Python library API found, so whether these count as 'public API' is not settleable by a concrete check.
